name: Vista Global Holding (VistaJet, XO)
note: Dubai-headquartered private aviation group; owns VistaJet and XO (rhonegroup.com portfolio page). Founded by entrepreneur Thomas Flohr (Rhône). An RRJ Capital-led consortium with Andalusian Private Capital agreed a $600m equity investment in March 2025, joining existing shareholders incl. Rhône Group (Private Jet Card Comparisons, 2025-03-17).
